checks.rationale: Six passive prey entries include retained Tundra Stag and five explicit new asset gaps. All remain nonaggressive at night and cannot retaliate with quills. Random encounters respect habitat/progression/route eligibility; essential meat is attainable. Defeat, pickup, carry, storage, applicable processing/service and payment are conserved; survivors can hunt and return meat.

UI appearance cannot change world time, RNG or rewards. Active actors, jobs, drops, saved clock and encounter state survive transitions.

checks.rationale: Player/pet priority, camp-assault targeting, attacker-specific survivor retaliation and both-player-and-pets-too-far exceptions remain explicit. Night does not broaden eligibility. Every scheduled raid retains its origin and 300 active-play seconds of named-camp warning before damage; ambient relabeling cannot bypass it. Raid intervals and unresolved casualty accounting remain open.

checks.dimension: All pets and prior map/display obligations
checks.rationale: Guardian dog, gray wolf, fox, owl, male lion, white tiger and brown bear retain attacks and useful specialties, with multiple useful pets/survivors and no added slot cap. The prior 21-row pet/map/display contract remains byte-identical in the index and has no working-tree diff. UI03/UI04 carry forward map knowledge, scouting value and actual-window adaptation obligations.

checks.dimension: Natural decisions and complete motion evidence
checks.rationale: MO01–MO06 cover purpose, stable productive jobs, individual/herd variation, avoidance, yielding, routes, gaits, foot/hoof/paw planting, toe/knee/hock mechanics, weight, loaded/tool-ready poses and full lifecycle transitions. Actual normal/slow multi-angle playback, contact closeups and audio listening are required later. Stills, a walk clip or a schema cannot approve motion.

The plan preserves ten worlds of fifty local levels and World 1 first, without all actors at Level 1 or invented unlocks. P-stage sequencing is explicitly separate from the unchanged task DAG. The full T54/T53 and downstream acceptance dependency mismatch is disclosed, with a scoped World 1 route required before implementation acceptance.

Only five entrypoints plus the new planning/evidence package change. Four entrypoint bodies recover byte-identically after header removal; the build plan also has exactly two disclosed product-prose replacements. Prior contracts, graph, registry, selector, policies, receipts, assets and workflows remain unchanged. Stronger 9.9/exact-10 reference gates remain mandatory for future runtime work.

checks.rationale: All 30 full Markdown rows match their JSON text, task lists and acceptance text. The independently executed validator passes 41 document checks. Nineteen parent-source bindings and ten input-source identities match exact bytes. The one metadata defect is repaired and retested. All 30 runtime obligations remain UNTESTED_FOR_NEW_RUNTIME_SCOPE; publication and merge are not certified by this review.
